options.content: Reports on network times, multi-cloud information, and API workflows.

panels.description: Shows network issues and for each Cloud and Region

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    CONCAT(callID, '_', resultID) AS id,  
    ipAddr AS ip_address,
    ${ipAddr_latitude} AS latitude,  
    ${ipAddr_longitude} AS longitude,
    cloud AS cloud_provider,
    ${ipAddr_city} AS city
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
AND callID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND resultID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND ipAddr != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
-- 🔴 Remove Private IPs & Blank Target IPs
AND notEmpty(cloud_provider)
AND NOT (
    -- Exclude Private IPs
    ipAddr LIKE '10.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.16.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.17.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.18.%' 
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.19.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.20.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.21.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.22.%' 
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.23.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.24.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.25.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.26.%' 
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.27.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.28.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.29.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.30.%' 
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.31.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '192.168.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '169.254.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '127.%'
)
LIMIT 300

UNION ALL 

SELECT DISTINCT 
    CONCAT(resultID, '_', callID) AS id,  
    targetIPAddr AS ip_address,
    ${targetIPAddr_latitude} AS latitude,  
    ${targetIPAddr_longitude} AS longitude,
    targetCloud AS cloud_provider,
    ${targetIPAddr_city} AS city
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
AND callID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND resultID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND targetIPAddr != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
-- 🔴 Remove Private IPs & Blank Target IPs
AND notEmpty(cloud_provider)
AND NOT (
    -- Exclude Private IPs
    targetIPAddr LIKE '10.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.16.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.17.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.18.%' 
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.19.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.20.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.21.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.22.%' 
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.23.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.24.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.25.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.26.%' 
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.27.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.28.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.29.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.30.%' 
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.31.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '192.168.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '169.254.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '127.%'
)

ORDER BY id
LIMIT 300
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Networking issues for all API calls; query=nodes; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT 
    CONCAT(callID, '_', resultID) AS source,   -- 👈 Ensure this matches the node ID
    CONCAT(resultID, '_', callID) AS target,   -- 👈 Ensure this matches the node ID
    (${sum_dns} + ${sum_connect} + ${sum_tlsHandshake}) AS network_time, -- Network Time Calculation
    cloud AS source_cloud, 
    targetCloud AS target_cloud, 
    ${ipAddr_city} AS source_city, 
    ${targetIPAddr_city} AS target_city,

    -- 🚦 Edge Coloring Logic
    CASE 
        WHEN (${sum_dns} + ${sum_connect} + ${sum_tlsHandshake}) < 50 THEN '1-green'   
        WHEN (${sum_dns} + ${sum_connect} + ${sum_tlsHandshake}) BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN '2-yellow'  
        ELSE '3-red'   
    END AS edge_color_text,

    -- 🔹 Edge Thickness based on Performance
    CASE 
        WHEN (${sum_dns} + ${sum_connect} + ${sum_tlsHandshake}) < 50 THEN 2  
        WHEN (${sum_dns} + ${sum_connect} + ${sum_tlsHandshake}) BETWEEN 50 AND 200 THEN 4  
        ELSE 6  
    END AS edge_thickness

FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
-- 🔴 Remove Private IPs & Blank Target IPs
AND isNotNull(targetIPAddr)
AND notEmpty(targetIPAddr)
AND isNotNull(ipAddr)
AND notEmpty(target_city)

AND callID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND resultID != '~~~SAMPLED_OUT~~~'
AND NOT (
    -- Exclude Private IPs (Source)
    ipAddr LIKE '10.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.16.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.17.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.18.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.19.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.20.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.21.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.22.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.23.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.24.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.25.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.26.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.27.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '172.28.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.29.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.30.%' OR ipAddr LIKE '172.31.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '192.168.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '169.254.%'
    OR ipAddr LIKE '127.%'

    -- Exclude Private IPs (Target)
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '10.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.16.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.17.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.18.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.19.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.20.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.21.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.22.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.23.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.24.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.25.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.26.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.27.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.28.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.29.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.30.%' OR targetIPAddr LIKE '172.31.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '192.168.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '169.254.%'
    OR targetIPAddr LIKE '127.%'
)
GROUP BY source, target, source_cloud, target_cloud, source_city, target_city, startTime
ORDER BY ${timestamp} DESC  -- 🕒 Sort by most recent data
LIMIT 300  -- 📉 Keep results manageable
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Networking issues for all API calls; query=edges; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Networking issues for all API calls

panels.description: Shows the average Connect time for each metadataDomain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  ${avg_tcp_connect_time} AS AVG, 
  metadataDomain
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, metadataDomain
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Average TCP connect time; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Shows the average DNS time for each Metadata Domain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,

panels.description: Shows the sum of the averages of TlsHandshake, Connect, and DNS for each Metadata Domain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  ${avg_tls_handshake_time} + ${avg_tcp_connect_time} + ${avg_dns_lookup_time} AS Time,
  metadataDomain
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, metadataDomain
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total networking time (DNS + TCP + SSL); du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Shows the Cloud, Connect, and DNS average time for each Cloud.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  ${avg_tls_handshake_time} + ${avg_tcp_connect_time} + ${avg_dns_lookup_time} AS Time, 
  cloud
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, cloud
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total networking time (By Cloud); du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Total networking time (By Cloud)

panels.description: Shows the Average Response Time groping by Location ID and cloud.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  ${ipAddr_latitude} AS Latitude, 
  ${ipAddr_longitude} AS Longitude, 
  cloud, 
  locationID, 
  ${avg_dns_lookup_time} as AvgResponseTime 
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})  
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND Latitude != '0'
  AND Longitude != '0'
GROUP BY locationID, Longitude, Latitude, cloud
LIMIT 500
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=DNS around the world; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: DNS around the world

panels.description: Shows the Average time for Connect, Proccesing and TlsHandShake.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS time, 
    ${avg_tcp_connect_time} AS avg_connect, 
    ${avg_processing_time} AS avg_processing, 
    ${avg_tls_handshake_time} AS avg_tls_handshake
FROM ${table}
WHERE 
    ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time ASC
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Latency Breakdown by Metric; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Latency Breakdown by Metric

panels.description: Shows the total requests for each Metadata Domain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  metadataDomain,
  COUNT() as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY metadataDomain
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top Domains; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Domains

panels.description: Shows the total requests and tlsHandshake average time for each Region.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    ${ipAddr_city} as region,
    ${ipAddr_latitude} AS latitude, 
    ${ipAddr_longitude} AS longitude, 
    ${avg_tls_handshake_time} AS avg_tls_handshake,
    ${failed_requests} AS failed_requests,
    ${cnt_all} AS total_requests,
    ${error_rate} AS error_rate
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND notEmpty(region)
GROUP BY region, latitude, longitude
ORDER BY region
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Combined Regional SLA Heatmap; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Combined Regional SLA Heatmap

panels.description: Shows the total requests for each Context Category.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  contextCategory,
  ${cnt_all} AS Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, contextCategory
ORDER BY time
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Categories; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Categories

panels.description: Shows the TlsHandshake average time for each Region and Cloud

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    ${ipAddr_city} as region, 
    ${ipAddr_latitude} AS latitude,
    ${ipAddr_longitude} AS longitude,
    cloud,
    ${avg_tls_handshake_time} AS avg_tls_handshake
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND notEmpty(region)
GROUP BY region, latitude, longitude, cloud
ORDER BY avg_tls_handshake DESC
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Regional TLS Handshake Performance; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Regional TLS Handshake Performance

panels.description: Shows the total requests for each Status Code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  toStartOfInterval(${timestamp}, INTERVAL ${__interval_s:raw} SECOND) AS time,
  toString(httpCode) as statusCode,
  ${cnt_all} as Code
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY time, statusCode
ORDER BY Code DESC
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp="Total Code" codes; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes

panels.description: Shows the total requests for each Cloud and Continent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  cloud as Cloud, 
  ${ipAddr_continent} as Continent,
  ${cnt_all} as Total
FROM ${table}
WHERE ${timestamp} >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND ${timestamp} <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND notEmpty(Continent)
GROUP BY Cloud, Continent
ORDER BY Total DESC
LIMIT 10000
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top location IDs; du=${__user.login}'
